lines.text: حامله سیما از حرم پادشاه و فرماندهان و شناعت عورات و بی مهری ایشان و کثرت
lines.en: pregnant women, especially from the harem of the king and commanders, and the infamy of women and their lack of affection, and the abundance of

lines.text: امطار و رعد و برق و کثرت بخور و رنج اهل طرب و عسرت وضع حمل و کساد اقمشه
lines.en: rains, thunder, and lightning, and the abundance of incense, and the suffering of the people of joy, and the difficulty of childbirth, and the stagnation of fabrics,

lines.text: و دل مشغولی خلایق و اگر زحل متصل باشد موت زنان خاطئه سیما زنان ملوك و
lines.en: and the preoccupation of the people. And if Saturn is conjoined, the death of sinful women, especially the women of kings, and

lines.text: کثرت باران و رعد و برق و سرمای مفرط و اگر زهره متصل باشد مخالفت اهل
lines.en: the abundance of rain, thunder, and lightning, and excessive cold. And if Venus is conjoined, the opposition of the people of

lines.text: ارمنیه بود با ملك بابل و شدت برود و کثرت امطار (مقارنه عطارد و زحل در
lines.en: Armenia with the king of Babylon, and the intensity of cold and the abundance of rains. (The conjunction of Mercury and Saturn in

lines.text: مثلثات اربع) مقارنه عطارد با زحل مطلقا دلالت کند بر افراط برودت هوا و
lines.en: the four triplicities) The conjunction of Mercury with Saturn absolutely indicates the excess of coldness of the air and

lines.text: حدوث برف مفرط در زمستان و اعتدال تابستان زیرا که عطارد بالطبع سرد و
lines.en: the occurrence of excessive snow in winter and the moderation of summer, because Mercury is by nature cold and

lines.text: خشکست و چون کسب طبیعت متصل باو میکند هرگاه متصل بزحل گردد کمال برودت
lines.en: dry, and since it acquires the nature of the one conjoined with it, whenever it is conjoined with Saturn, the perfection of coldness

lines.text: شود سبب برف و سرما گردد در وقت پس اگر در انوقت قوی بود دلالت کند بر
lines.en: becomes the cause of snow and cold at that time. So if it is strong at that time, it indicates

lines.text: کسب علوم دقیقه مانند هندسه و فلسفه و بیرون اوردن اسرار و غوامض امور
lines.en: the acquisition of exact sciences like geometry and philosophy, and bringing out secrets and the obscurities of matters.

lines.text: و اگر عطارد اقوی بود دلالت کند بر رغبت مردمان بتحصیل انواع علوم و صناعات
lines.en: And if Mercury is stronger, it indicates the inclination of people to acquire various sciences and crafts,

lines.text: و حدوث بیماری و رنج در بلاد روم و بالجمله متزاج این دو کوکب دلیل است بر دروغ
lines.en: and the occurrence of disease and suffering in the lands of Rome. And in general, the mixture of these two planets is a sign of lies,

lines.text: گفتن و مکر و تزویر و سحر و شعبده و اظهار کیمیا و توقف تجار در سفرها و بی رونقی
lines.en: speaking, and deceit, and trickery, and magic, and sleight of hand, and the manifestation of alchemy, and the delay of merchants in journeys, and the lack of prosperity

lines.text: بازارها و منتهی شدن معاملات و وقوع اخبار اراجیف و کثرت هوام و موت یکی
lines.en: of markets, and the ending of transactions, and the occurrence of false news, and the abundance of vermin, and the death of one

lines.text: از ملوك در ولایت مغرب (مقارنه عطارد و زحل در مثلثه اتشی) دلالت کند بر
lines.en: of the kings in the western province. (The conjunction of Mercury and Saturn in the fiery triplicity) indicates

lines.text: بد شدن احوال دبیران و اصحاب دواوین و نوشتن خطوط ناحق و افتادن اراجیف
lines.en: the worsening of the conditions of secretaries and the people of the diwans, and the writing of unjust lines, and the falling of false rumors

lines.text: و زدن سکه مزوره و رنج صناع و کساد بازارها و تازه شدن سخنان گذشته و
lines.en: and the striking of forged coins, and the suffering of artisans, and the stagnation of markets, and the renewal of past words, and

lines.text: امدن کاروانها و وقوع معاملات بی نفع و تغییر هوا و سرما و رعد و برق در شتی
lines.en: the coming of caravans, and the occurrence of unprofitable transactions, and the change of weather, and cold, and thunder, and lightning in winter,

lines.text: و فساد کشت و زرع و تفاوت نرخها و بیماریهای سوداوی مثل صرع و جنون و
lines.en: and the corruption of crops and agriculture, and the difference in prices, and melancholic diseases like epilepsy and madness, and

lines.text: رنج اطفال و بیع برده و عقاقیر و بدی حال نقاشان و اهل قلم و حشم پادشاه و
lines.en: the suffering of children, and the sale of slaves and drugs, and the bad condition of painters and the people of the pen and the retinue of the king, and

lines.text: عظما و وکلا و تحویلداران و ساحران (و اگر در حمل باشد) دلالت کند بر ضعف
lines.en: the great ones, and deputies, and cashiers, and sorcerers. (And if it is in Aries) it indicates the weakness

lines.text: حال اهل دیوان و ارباب دفاتر و نوشتن خطوط مزوره و خیانت خلایق و کساد
lines.en: of the condition of the people of the diwan and the masters of registers, and the writing of forged lines, and the betrayal of the people, and the stagnation

lines.text: بازارها و خرید و فروخت برده و گوسفند و افت کشتیها و رعد و برق و سرما
lines.en: of markets, and the buying and selling of slaves and sheep, and the disaster of ships, and thunder, and lightning, and cold.

sections.en: The conjunction of Mercury and Saturn

summary.headline: Mercury–Saturn Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of Mercury–Saturn conjunctions, describing effects on weather, childbirth, markets, crafts, scholarship, magic, alchemy, disease, rulers, and political regions. Separate forecasts are given for the fiery triplicity and Aries, including forged writing and coinage, trade stagnation, crop damage, shipwrecks, thunder, lightning, and cold.
